# Barcode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A native, vector-based 1D barcode element. Renders sharp, scannable bars as filled rectangles sized in PDF points, with an optional human-readable text label beneath. Mirrors the shape of `QRCode` so the two are learned together.

Encoding is pure managed code with zero dependencies. The bar patterns are identical to the BonniePDF TypeScript implementation for the same input.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Barcode()
```

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alternate text description for accessibility. When the document opts into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`, this populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element wrapping the barcode.

### `BackgroundColor`

```csharp
Color BackgroundColor { get; set; }
```

The background colour. Default white (recommended for reliable scanning).

### `DrawBackground`

```csharp
bool DrawBackground { get; set; }
```

Whether to draw the background. Default true.

### `ForegroundColor`

```csharp
Color ForegroundColor { get; set; }
```

The colour of the bars. Default black.

### `Gs1`

```csharp
bool Gs1 { get; set; }
```

Encodes Code 128 with the GS1 start and field separators.

### `Height`

```csharp
float Height { get; set; }
```

Height of the bars in points (excludes the text label). Default 60.

### `IncludeTextLabel`

```csharp
bool IncludeTextLabel { get; set; }
```

Whether to render the human-readable value beneath the bars. Default true.

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp

```

When `true`, the barcode is tagged as a decorative `/Artifact`.

### `ModuleWidth`

```csharp
float ModuleWidth { get; set; }
```

Width of the narrowest bar (one module) in points. Default 1.5.

### `QuietZone`

```csharp
int QuietZone { get; set; }
```

Number of quiet-zone modules on each side. Defaults to the per-symbology spec value.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.

### `Symbology`

```csharp
BarcodeSymbology Symbology { get; set; }
```

The barcode symbology. Defaults to `Code128`.

### `TextLabelFontSize`

```csharp
float TextLabelFontSize { get; set; }
```

Font size of the human-readable text label, in points. Default 9.

### `Value`

```csharp
string Value { get; set; }
```

The value to encode. Content rules depend on `Symbology`.
